label: TAF15::NR4A3

sections.text: TAF15 encodes an RNA-binding transcriptional regulator in the FET protein family.
NR4A3 encodes an orphan nuclear-receptor transcription factor.

The fusion combines a FET-family activation region with the NR4A3 nuclear-receptor transcription factor and dysregulates its transcriptional output. It is a recurrent driver in extraskeletal myxoid chondrosarcoma.
